title: 第7章 打不过就加入那就先打一顿第8章 这一拳很疼
slug: 一年抽取一词条模拟的也可以
lines: 从凡人提升至炼体境，也是武道境界的提升。
陈奕可装备的词条数、各品质词条的概率，跟着提升了！
【姓名：陈奕】
【境界：炼体三段】
【功法：莽牛劲（低阶，入门）】
【已装备词条（35）：模拟器[彩]、三角肌发达[白]、耐饿[白]】
【已获取词条（80）：认真的一拳[绿]、努力必有收获[绿]、越老迈越幸运[绿]、低阶根骨[绿]……】
【当前各品质词条概率：】
【白色普通89%，绿色稀有9%，紫色史诗1%，金色传说0.99%，棱彩神话0.01%】
一口气多了一大堆词条。
乍一看，占据大多数的白色词条都没什么用。
实际上，也确实没什么用。
但好歹是一个个独特的效果，在某些特定情况下，说不定能派上用场。
陈奕现在能装备五个词条。
他给词条按照品质排了个序。
然后将“模拟器”
、“低阶根骨”
、“认真的一拳”
、“努力必有收获”
、“超兽的痛觉”
五个词条装备了上去。
陈奕现在很想知道下一次模拟如何开启。
心念一动，模拟器词条为他展示了文字提示。
【模拟冷却中，剩余一年。
【你可以选择完成以下指引任务，直接获得模拟机会。
【指引任务：打不过就加入！
【展露武者修为，混入黑石帮，从而寻找机会脱身！
【奖励：】
【2、精品词条抽取次数*1（精品词条的品质不一定高，但一定有正面效果）；】
【3、低阶灵器·炎铁重剑。
content_en:
The promotion from a mortal to the body refining realm is also an improvement in the martial arts realm.
The number of items equipped by Chen Yike and the probability of each quality item have increased accordingly!
[Name: Chen Yi]
[Realm: Third Stage of Body Refining]
[Exercise: Mang Niu Jin (low level, entry level)]
[Equipped entries (35): simulator [color], developed deltoid muscles [white], hunger resistance [white]]
[Acquired entries (80): A serious punch [green], hard work will pay off [green], the older you get, the luckier you get [green], low-level bones [green]...]
[Current probability of each quality entry:]
[White common 89%, green rare 9%, purple epic 1%, golden legend 0.99%, prismatic myth 0.01%]
A lot of entries were added in one go.
At first glance, the majority of white entries appear to be useless.
In fact, it's really useless.
But at least it is a unique effect, and in some specific situations, it may come in handy.
Chen Yi can now equip five entries.
He ranked the entries in order of quality.
Then change "emulator"
, "low-level root bones"
, "A serious punch"
, "Efforts will be rewarded"
, "Super beast's pain"
Five entries were equipped.
Chen Yi now wants to know how to start the next simulation.
As soon as he thought about it, the simulator entry showed him a text prompt.
[Simulation cooling in progress, one year remaining.
[You can choose to complete the following guided tasks to directly obtain simulation opportunities.
[Guidance mission: If you can’t beat it, join it!
[Show your martial arts skills and join the Blackstone Gang to find opportunities to escape!
[Reward:]
【1.Number of simulations+1;】
[2. The number of extractions of high-quality entries*1 (the quality of high-quality entries may not be high, but it must have a positive effect);]
[3. Low-level spiritual weapon: Flame Iron Heavy Sword.
